lines.text: How do you know my name?
A friend. Tall. Behind a tree.
His face is on the torch.
How do you get home in the dark?
Sir. There's a second coil. Something's feeding on it.
Sir. I wanted you to see this first.

sections.title: Love in the Time of NEPA

lines.text: I'm broke. Properly. Three hundred naira.
He said his sister fed the fish at the dam.
Doctor, if I bridge the theatre circuit—
Six. And the clock in the middle.
And a friend's. First name Muhammad.
Who was the seventh cup for?
Who's in charge of the pots?
We built it alone. It burned.
Tanko. The back stair. Which way?
Straight, then left at the clock.
I only came for the jollof.
Where's my roommate with my biscuits?
Still not a kind of cake.
I'm in business now. Kind of.
Three hundred level of what, exactly?
